title: fix(plugin-auth): answer a locked account like a wrong password, clear the lock on reset, count attempts atomically
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPWpc3NTXt4TesUX4RAeTzBw)_

Closes #28381

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:被锁定的账号用密码登录时,得到的回答与密码错误完全相同(状态码、正文、耗时一致);完成密码重置会清除锁定;每次尝试在校验密码之前就原子计数,并发尝试越不过阈值;控制台的登录错误文案说明「多次失败会暂停一段时间,重置密码可立即登录」(全部 11 种控制台语言)。
- 为什么改:原来的 `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` 只有真实存在的账号才会出现,等于告诉任何人某个邮箱是否注册过;重置密码后锁还在,用户换了密码仍登不进;并发尝试能越过阈值。
- 风险与回滚:登录路径的行为变化,默认对锁定账号不再给出专门的提示;想保留原来 403 的部署设 `lockoutRefusal: 'explicit'` 即可;绕过 better-auth 端点管道的调用无法给出统一回答,会得到 403 并记一条降级日志。无数据迁移,回滚 = revert 本 PR。cloud 目前在两个平面上自行改写这个回答,本 PR 不动 cloud,改写由 cloud 在之后的 pin 轮次里撤掉。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-sign-in-lockout.ts`(计数与上锁的原子写入、成功清零、密码通过后的拒绝退回计数)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sign-in-lockout-refusal.ts`(锁定账号如何得到与密码错误相同的回答)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`(重置清锁的接线)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/account-lockout-resolved-account.test.ts src/password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts`,预期两个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **A locked account is answered like a wrong password.** A password sign-in for an account the ADR-0069 D2 lockout holds is now refused `401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD`, with the same body and the same password-check cost a wrong password gets. The lock still holds against the correct password, and the account's `login_failed` audit row still records the reason `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`. A deployment that wants the explicit answer sets the new `AuthManagerOptions.lockoutRefusal: 'explicit'` (default `'uniform'`) and is answered `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` as before. A sign-in that runs outside better-auth's endpoint pipeline cannot be answered uniformly; it is refused `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` and logged as a degradation, so the lock still holds.
- **A completed password reset clears the lock.** A reset through the emailed link or the phone code clears `failed_login_count` and `locked_until`, so the new password signs in at once. An incomplete reset clears nothing. The second factor's own lock is not cleared by a reset; the administrator's Unlock action still clears both.
- **Concurrent attempts cannot exceed the threshold.** Each attempt is counted before its password is checked, in one atomic write that also stamps the lock when the count reaches the threshold. A successful sign-in still clears the count, and a refusal that comes after the password passed (an organization's IP list, a ban, an unverified address) still neither counts nor clears.
- **The console names the pause.** `auth.login.errors.invalidCredentials` now says repeated failures pause sign-in for a while and that resetting the password signs in right away, in all 11 console locales (`en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `ja`, `ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`), so `check:i18n-drift` holds.

**Clause-② for the opt-in key.** `lockoutRefusal` is a new optional key on `AuthManagerOptions`, the constructor options of the published `@objectstack/plugin-auth`. It widens what that package accepts, so the line reads `yes (widening)`. It is not a settings key and nothing in `packages/spec` changes, so `Metadata-protocol` stays `none` and the changeset is `patch`.

## Tests

- `account-lockout-resolved-account.test.ts` (real sign-in endpoint): a locked account answers exactly what a wrong password answers, the correct password included (status, body, and one password derivation each, counted with the scrypt testkit for an open account's wrong password, a locked account's correct and wrong password, and an unknown account); input refusals match too; a locked refusal opens no session and writes the `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` audit row; `lockoutRefusal: 'explicit'` answers `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED`; of 30 concurrent wrong passwords, exactly the threshold reach the password check, the rest meet the lock, one `account_locked` row is written, and the lock then holds against the correct password.
- `password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts` (real ObjectQL + sqlite): a reset by emailed link and by phone code each clear the lock and the new password signs in at once; an incomplete reset leaves the lock.
- `auth-manager.test.ts`: the lockout unit block, rewritten for the new gate (no-op at threshold 0, the uniform and explicit refusals, the refusal and its log line outside the pipeline, a locked attempt counted without moving its expiry, the compare-and-set write below and at the threshold, a re-read after a lost write, success clearing). Its fake engine now opens `update` with `assertEngineUpdateDispatch`, so every write the block makes is one the real engine accepts.
- `auth-account-event-audit.test.ts` and `durability-swallow-repair.test.ts`: updated to the uniform answer and the renamed gate.
- NULL counter (seat review): `password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts` › "ADR-0069 D2: an account whose failed_login_count is NULL is counted and cleared through ObjectQL + SqlDriver" (better-sqlite3; the column is read back as NULL first) and `account-lockout-resolved-account.test.ts` › "ADR-0069 D2: an account whose failed_login_count is NULL or absent is counted and cleared like one at 0" (in-memory, NULL and absent): the correct password signs in and clears the counter to 0; a wrong password counts to 1 and the correct one still signs in after it. The compare-and-set matches a NULL counter on both engines, so no normalisation was needed. SqlDriver compiles every dialect through one filter compiler; only sqlite was run.

Reverse verification: with the implementation committed, the plugin-auth source files were restored from `eff90af6` and the two endpoint-level files run against them: 10 failed and 25 passed (the uniform answer under every spelling and input, the reset clearing in all three cases, and the concurrency pin). `git checkout HEAD -- …` restored the implementation, with `git diff HEAD` empty, and both files are green again.

## Acceptance notes

- **The opt-in is config-only.** `lockoutRefusal` is read from the constructor options; there is no settings key and no UI for it.
- **cloud is untouched.** cloud rewrites this answer on both planes today; dropping that rewrite is a cloud card after a pin round carries this change.
- **Where the concurrency pin runs.** The 30-attempt pin runs on the in-memory engine, whose `update` honours `where` + `multi` and returns the row count; the reset pins run on real ObjectQL + sqlite.
- **Files outside `plugin-auth/**` and the console copy.** Three generated or ratchet files move with this diff, each written by its own tool: `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`; two `sys_user` write sites now read as a typed engine receiver, so the page's two hand-written erased-receiver figures go from 64 to 62, with the total unchanged at 270), and `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` (`check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`; one more pinned fake in `auth-manager.test.ts`). The seat agreed to the census page before it was written.
- **Test-typecheck debt shrank.** Typing the lockout block's engine mock removed 16 recorded test type errors in `auth-manager.test.ts`; `test-typecheck-debt.json` was re-recorded downward with the package's own `gen:test-typecheck-debt`.
- **The wrong-password code is not in the ADR-0112 ledger.** `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` is better-auth's code and reaches the wire unregistered. Stamping it from plugin-auth would need a ledger row in `packages/spec`, which this card does not touch, so the one path that would have stamped it (outside the endpoint pipeline) uses the registered `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` instead. Registering the code would let that path answer uniformly too; left for the seat to schedule.
- **Body order.** The two attribution lines the session adds sit above `Closes #28381`.

## Verification

The readings below were taken at head `42421e44`. At head `00c88e7e` (NULL-counter tests and the 7 locale packs), under the lock: plugin-auth typecheck OK and 240/240 files, 4267 tests; ui i18n, console auth, `check-i18n-call-site-keys` and `check-i18n-en-drift`: 115/115 files, 2094 tests; the changeset, engine-double, NUL and i18n-drift gates green. Wall-clock figures come from a shared box.
